Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 6.1, 7.4; court E. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: M1 implementation.
Integration parent: bd-01M16KDH0TM7DF2BC0K08TH0TT; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7B6R63M4B10R3J3XBW54, bd-01M35A7A2XPBXBSTP1FXM7PQMX.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own UI result/projection controls and the Atlas side of the checked M1-to-Voyage adapter. Scientific adapter and compatibility come from StoryModel adoption. Preserve original alternatives, decision origin, mapping-run labels and common inventory even for legacy-unsupported outcomes.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Two supplied compatible results switch without estimator execution or identity loss; absent candidate in the new run is explicitly not supplied, not given an old value.
2. Lawful timed synthetic fixture switches source/matrix/Voyage with preserved qualified selection; untimed text reports unavailable clock projection without casting offsets/ordinals to seconds.
3. Incompatible joins refuse and unavailable reference remains unavailable. Legacy unsupported failed/outcome rows remain inspectable in the shared inventory/inspector.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Keep source/matrix for unsupported clocks and standalone legacy Voyage; never relabel reconstruction as reference.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [M1] Integrate compatible result switches and lawful Voyage projection
